name: Ruined Reaches
summary: Along Azshara’s southern coast, the Ruined Reaches lie beneath the mainland cliffs. Wrecked ships and dangerous shallows mark the beaches, while predators haunt the surf and a small gnomish outpost watches from above.

sections.title: A Battered Coast
sections.body:
The Ruined Reaches stretch along southern Azshara, just north of Durotar. Rocky inlets and cliff faces break up the sand, where wreckage washes ashore. Like the Jagged Reef farther north, hidden shallows make sea travel perilous. Many ships have broken against this coast.

Hostile creatures roam both beach and water. Territorial murlocs, vicious hydras, and armored makrura make crossing the shore as dangerous as crossing the surf.

sections.title: The Gadgetspring Outpost
sections.body: A steep trail climbs from the beaches to a gnomish workshop high on the western cliff. Blimo and Jubie Gadgetspring keep the outpost, selling engineering components and general trade goods to travelers. An elevator leads up to private quarters with three beds. Who, if anyone, sleeps in the third bunk remains unknown.

faq.q: Where are the Ruined Reaches located?
aliases: how to get to ruined reaches
faq.answer: The Ruined Reaches follow Azshara’s southern coast, along the northern edge of Durotar. Beaches, coastal inlets, and cliffs lie beneath the mainland bluffs.

faq.q: What threats inhabit this stretch of coast?
faq.answer: Hostile creatures prowl the beaches and shallow waters. Aggressive murloc tribes, multi-headed hydras, and makrura haunt the tidal flats.

faq.q: Who lives in the gnomish structure on the cliffs?
aliases: who lives in the gnome house
faq.answer: Blimo and Jubie Gadgetspring live and work in the cliffside outpost. Their small shop sells engineering parts and trade supplies to travelers on the coast.

faq.q: Why are there so many shipwrecks here?
faq.answer: Like the nearby Jagged Reef, this coast hides shallow rocks and other hazards. Ships can strike them unaware and break against the cliffs.

angles.text: Blimo and Jubie Gadgetspring’s remote workshop offers useful parts and supplies to engineers exploring Azshara’s wilds.
A gnomish homestead high on Azshara’s hostile cliffs shows the resourcefulness of gnomes far from Ironforge.
